messages: Lina: quick sync on Stack Inspector UX — noticed a couple of things users hit: export discoverability, copy ID feedback, and focus flow in the modal. Tom: saw that too. users are opening the overflow menu then wondering why export isn't obvious. Priya: we should avoid making export feel primary, but it does need to be reachable without hunting. Lina: proposal: move Export control earlier in the DOM so it appears in the main Tab order, but keep it visually grouped under More via CSS. label change: from 'Export' -> 'Export trace (.json)' to clarify output. Sam: ops concern: if export is more visible people will hit it accidentally on huge traces. can we show file-size estimate and a confirmation? Tom: yeah add a small filesize line in the modal: "Estimated export size: 2.3MB" and a checkbox for "Include full logs" so default stays modest. Priya: product comment: A/B test the label text. alternate label 'Download trace' might be clearer for some users. we'll run a short experiment. Lina: accessibility nits: copy confirmation currently only shows a toast which disappears; screen readers don't get notified. need aria-live announcement and ensure toast meets contrast. A11yBot: recommended pattern: invisible status node with role="status" and aria-live="polite" that gets updated when copy completes. ensure focus isn't stolen. Tom: here's a minimal snippet I'll use: ```html ``` Lina: minor copy question: should the button read 'Copy ID' or 'Copy correlation ID'? shorter is nice but might be ambiguous outside context. Priya: accept 'Copy ID' when visually adjacent to the label 'Correlation ID'. otherwise keep full text. small-screen edge-case: use full text in tooltip. Sam: modal focus: when opening export modal focus moves into dialog fine, but on close focus currently jumps to top-left of the page. we should restore focus to the original Export trigger. Tom: will implement focus restore and ensure background is aria-hidden when modal open. Lina: also noticed export modal title 'Trace export' — prefer 'Export trace — options' or 'Export trace — include logs & spans' to make choices clearer. Priya: note for i18n: changing modal title affects translations; file a short i18n ticket. Sam: performance follow-up: very large traces (>8MB) need a streaming export or server-side job. I'll take an SRE ticket to add a warning & async job option. Lina: can we bundle DOM reorder, aria-live, focus restore, and modal title change into one small PR? leave text A/B and translation changes as follow-ups. Tom: yes will do a single PR with unit tests for keyboard order and an accessibility smoke test. A11yBot: also include automated contrast and keyboard nav checks in CI. Priya: I'll create the A/B ticket and QA checklist. include screenshots for QA. Sam: tagging for follow-up: @Sam (SRE) will pick up large-export job. Lina: thanks all. I'll update the Figma frames and post the QA checklist here once ready. :thumbsup:
